title: Hallmark Peanuts Woodstock Earmuffs & Scarf Plush 8in - New
descriptionText: The Hallmark Woodstock Peanuts Collection Earmuffs Scarf Stuffed Plush is an 8-inch plush toy featuring the beloved character Woodstock from the Peanuts franchise. The stuffed animal is designed in a vibrant yellow color, perfect for adding a pop of personality to your winter attire. Made of plush material, this collectible item is a must-have for fans of the Charlie Brown TV show and Peanuts series, bringing a touch of nostalgia and charm to any collection.
